method: Blinded review of listed case files, prompts, candidate/reference sources and frozen Node oracles; no arm identity or other analysis read. Source trees hashed by sorted relative path and file content: all four reference copies per task matched. Frozen oracles run unchanged; supplemental Node checks for strict-equality failures. No aggregate alternate score.

coverage_summary.dispatch-ambiguity: Four cases: source and oracle support registry-dependent selection and distinct legacy path.
coverage_summary.zero-quantity: Four cases: specified runtime checks pass; three added a test file outside case.json allowed_changes, a restriction not explicitly stated in visible prompt and not enforced by the frozen Node oracle.
coverage_summary.inventory-contract: Four cases: claims and behavior supported; one fails strict equality because file/symbol objects replace expected path strings.
coverage_summary.receipt-location: Four cases: owner, key and outbound behavior supported; three fail strict equality on chain representation. Similar helpers are not explicitly described in answers; a linear chain can obscure sibling calls.

unresolved_uncertainty_or_errors: Answer identifies the active owner but does not explicitly describe what the similarly named report and transport helpers do; exact requested top-level keys provide no dedicated comparison field.
A linear list including makeReceiptKey can suggest a nested call chain; actual sibling calls from submitInvoice are shown in source.

makeReceiptKey is recorded as key_from on the submitInvoice object rather than as a separate call_chain entry; the actual key-producing call is accurately represented but the required ordered-symbol representation is ambiguous.
cases.source_claim_accuracy: Correct key owner and outbound header owner, example, and route. submitInvoice calls makeReceiptKey and then sendInvoice; makeReceiptKey does not itself call sendInvoice. Other same-named helpers produce a report key or read a response header, respectively.
